game_title: Trace Table Race – Dungeon Stairs Race
game_concept: A adventure race set in The Kingdom – Dungeon Stairs, the castle dungeon stairwell: the baker's apprentice must handle goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Trace Table Race: Fill a trace table showing each variable after every line of a mini program.
theme: The Kingdom – Dungeon Stairs: the castle dungeon stairwell
core_gameplay_loop: Read the requested procedure, drag flowchart shapes into the chart, then run checks against example inputs and expected outputs.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the signal beacon by solving code steps involving trace_rows_correct that move the baker's apprentice forward.
controls: Drag blocks from the tray into chart positions. Drag them back to remove them. Check chart runs the algorithm. Keyboard: [ or ] selects a block, arrows choose a position, Enter places, C checks, Escape pauses.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the signal beacon first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: CP1 Week 1: Controls and mission practice
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Trace Table Race' (Week 1 slot 14), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Dungeon Stairs'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trace_rows_correct changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against goblin raiders in Dungeon Stairs.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.9).
